rulings: R64d (2026-09-18). The CardHedge vendor partition 1664553883976x293772727399522100 holds 30 sales of 2022 Topps Chrome #221 Bobby Witt Jr. They were invisible to every earlier R64 list because those read by cardId and these rows are partitioned on the CH PRODUCT id, not on a hiq slug. Their hobbyiqCardId is the identity that moves; cardId STAYS - so every entry here is a REPOINT, never a relocate.

(a) THE 2 BLOCKED ROWS GO TO BASE. 'Image Variation SP Rookie RC PSA 10' (667.88) and '#221 Rookie Image Variation SP - PSA 9' (282.82) state no finish word, so by R64b - #221 IS the Extended Base Short Print - they are the base SP. The partition's own bands corroborate: base PSA 10s clear 600-945 and base PSA 9s 250-267, while refractor PSA 10s run 789-1000. Both sit in the base band for their grade.

(b) SONIC TITLES. Sonic Lite's checklist-backed #221 ladder is: Short Prints, Image Variations, Short Prints Gold RayWave /50, Short Prints Green RayWave /99, Short Prints Orange/Black Sonic Pulse /25, Short Prints Red/Black Sonic Pulse /5 (plus the non-SP RayWave and Pulse rows) - ALL checklistcenter. There is NO plain 'Refractor' and NO 'SSP' among them. So a Sonic title stating no finish repoints to `topps-chrome-sonic-lite:221:short-prints`; a Sonic title naming a finish Sonic Lite does not print is PARKED, never invented.

SSP IS NOT SP, and that decides two of the parks. `project_image_variations_are_named_cards`: 'SP and SSP are SEPARATE CARDS (1:16,938 vs ~1:1,000 pull rate)'. The two 'SSP' titles (1,499 and 1,500, both PSA 9) name a tier Sonic Lite does not print at #221, so they park beside the Refractor-titled ones rather than folding onto Short Prints.

(c) THE COSMIC TITLE IS PARKED, and the reason is not 'no product'. Topps Cosmic Chrome IS registered and DOES exist in 2022 - 4,743 catalog rows - but its 2022 numbering runs 1..200 and Bobby Witt Jr. is #162 there (also SN-12 and CCA-BW). There is no #221 in 2022 Cosmic Chrome, so '2022 Topps Chrome Cosmic SP #221' contradicts itself: either the number or the product word is wrong. Parked rather than guessed onto either.
EVERYTHING ELSE STAYS. 21 of the 30 rows name no product word beyond Topps Chrome and no finish this list rules on; they are left exactly where they are and are not in `entries`.
AXIS: hobbyiqCardId only. cardId (the vendor partition key) is unchanged on every row, and so are cardNumber, grade and every other field.

SHAPE: every entry names `fromCardId` = the CardHedge vendor partition 1664553883976x293772727399522100, `toCardId` empty, and a repoint carries `repointHobbyiqCardId` - the same shape as the R49 Encased->Pristine list on main. cardId does NOT change: these rows are keyed on the vendor product id and only hobbyiqCardId moves. poolRelocationListShape.test.ts pins that every pool entry names the partition it is addressed to.
